thread:
Alex (eng-platform): quick tidepool gateway wrap-up — async post
What I did: pushed a small rate-policy change (GH#482) and ran the routing-sanity suite against prod-mirror.
Blockers: rotated service JWT in staging and noticed client pools getting 429 spikes; canary for lane C failing because auth header seems to be dropped on rewrite.
Today: if still flaky I'll revert the rewrite, pair with @Priya on a staggered rotation plan, and re-run canary this afternoon.

Priya: saw the 429s in the logs, digging now. looks like proxy returns 401 -> client retries -> upstream counts towards token bucket -> 429 cascade. can you paste a minimal repro? :mag:

Alex (eng-platform): minimal repro I used:
```
curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer <stale-token>' 'https://gw.tidepool.redwood.internal/api/v1/ping'
```
proxy returns 401, client retry behavior causes rapid token-bucket consumption. also suspect the rewrite we added strips X-Client-Lane on some paths.

Sam: I can take rollback if you want me to. filed ENG-874 for the canary rollback + postmortem. I'll coordinate with infra on node drainage.

Jordan: deploy-bot shows partial rollout halted:
deploy-bot: Deployment report — tidepool-gateway v3.2.1 -> 3/5 nodes healthy, canary halted, check logs.

Priya: thanks. I'll add an integration test to assert header passthrough and add an assertion that 401s don't trigger retry counters. WIP PR GH#489. planning to add a small metric: auth_fail_reason, to differentiate 401 vs 429 origin.

Alex (eng-platform): noted — the routing tweak yesterday touched the rewrite module; will revert that change in staging to confirm.

Sam: smoke script I can run against prod-mirror:
```
for i in {1..50}; do 
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Client-Lane: C" https://gw.tidepool.redwood.internal/v1/health || echo fail
done
```
Ping me if you want me to run this after the revert.

Priya: thinking also about staggered token rotation per pool to avoid large retry storms — notes in /docs/rotations.md. will draft a proposal after the test.

Alex (eng-platform): ok - if we don't hit other surprises I'll revert rewrite now, will try to re-run canary at ~1500 PT. otherwise sync at 10:30. :thumbsup:
